This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and ray-like frames, lacking arms or legs, instead possessing a pair of wing-like [[Limb/Legends|limbs]]. Capable of flight, they seemingly had few facial features, save for a [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]] on the underside of their bodies and potentially squinted eyes. They donned only strapped satchels for [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], at least two members of this species were present in a [[Casino on Qiaxx|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Qiaxx]].<ref name="MJ5" />

{{Species-stub}}
